The ambrox, absolute olfactory equivalent of physical desire, ever present in the highest concentration used in perfumery, is heated to the point of combustion with a mixture of ginger and vetiver, alliance of refinement and sensuality. As a crunchy layer of ice, the Hivernal underlines these contrasts and prolongs the dialogue between icy breath and a sensual breath, giving the fragrance a kind of eternity. Both Armani Code Armani Code Sport live in perfect harmony: a fragrance for day and evening; for the week and for the weekend; a fragrance for a subtle and intense seduction.
